name: cache-warmer
description: Keep the main conversation's prompt cache warm by automatically forking its last request, tools denied and billed like any request, shortly before the cache expires; switch its lifetime between 5m and 1h, and show each refresh's cost and estimated saving.

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: Main-conversation cache lifetime this mod sets; refreshes run at 90% of it. 1h writes cost 2x input instead of 1.25x.

idle5m.title: Idle refreshes, 5m
idle5m.description: Refreshes a 5-minute cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs the $0.05 expected saving.

idle1h.title: Idle refreshes, 1h
idle1h.description: Refreshes a 1-hour cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs the $0.05 expected saving.

compactGuard.title: Compact Guard
compactGuard.description: Off by default. Manual keeps native compaction under user control; experimental may request native compaction before cache expiry only when all guards pass. Minimum context pressure alone never triggers compaction.

compactMinPercent.title: Compact minimum pressure (%)
compactMinPercent.description: Minimum context pressure for experimental native compaction; this threshold alone never triggers compaction.

compactHeadroomTokens.title: Compact headroom tokens
compactHeadroomTokens.description: Required context headroom for experimental native compaction; all other guards must also pass.

compactLeadSeconds.title: Compact lead time (seconds)
compactLeadSeconds.description: Lead time before cache expiry for experimental native compaction; all other guards must also pass.

compactWakeTimeoutSeconds.title: Compact wake timeout (seconds)
compactWakeTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum wait for the experimental native-compaction wake request; a timeout does not permit retrying compaction automatically.

band.title: Refresh band
band.description: The band above the prompt while a refresh runs and for 5 seconds after it: default shows Clawd beside the notice, simplified one line, off nothing.
